item: How robots reach the Act (machinery reading)
what_the_source_says: Art. 2(2) as amended does limit Section B products to Art. 6(1), 60a and 102-112. The table's reading is therefore correct IF machinery is in Section B, which this retrieval could not confirm from official text. Also an AI safety component is only high-risk if the Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) conditions are met, and the new Art. 6(1a) to 1c narrow what counts as a safety component. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.

Para 1 replaced (refers to Art. 4a(1)); para 5 deleted; para 6 replaced (for systems not trained, paras 2 to 4 and Art. 4a(1) apply only to testing data sets). Art. 4a is new (special category data for bias detection). Base text of Art. 10 not seen officially. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.

Second subparagraph of para 1 replaced: SMEs (including start ups) and small mid caps may give Annex IV information in a simplified form set by the Commission, which notified bodies must accept. Only one version seen (the table mentions two versions on the unofficial page). Paragraph count of Art. 11 (table says 1 to 3) and Annex IV points not seen. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.
conflicts: Unofficial page showed two SME wordings; official extraction shows one.

what_the_source_says: Para 2 replaced: implementation proportionate to provider size, especially SMEs and small mid caps, while keeping the required level of rigour and protection. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.

A new subparagraph is added to paragraph 2 (Commission to request European standardisation organisations to develop deliverables supporting joint compliance). It is NOT a new paragraph 3. Table row says new paragraph 3 and Art. 40(1)-(3). Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.
conflicts: Explorer (unofficial) says new paragraph 3; Orrick says Art. 40(2). Official extraction supports Orrick.

what_the_source_says: Systems within Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 are deemed to meet Art. 15 cybersecurity requirements if Art. 12(1) of that Regulation conditions are met. Not in the table. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.

Paragraph 3 replaced. Notified bodies designated under Section A legislation may assess against Section 2 requirements; they must apply for designation under Section 4 'by 28 January 2028'. Also clarifies procedure for systems under both Annex I and Annex III. The table paraphrase follows older wording and omits this. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.

Art. 60(1) and (2) replaced: real world testing outside sandboxes covers Annex III and Annex I Section A systems, before placing on the market, alone or with deployers. New Art. 60a: Member States may allow real world testing of AI enabled products under Section B legislation. Other Art. 60 paragraphs (30 days, six months) not seen. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.

Plan is part of Annex IV technical documentation; Commission to issue guidance and template by 2 September 2027. This resolves the table's 2 Feb 2026 vs 2 Sep 2027 doubt in favour of 2 Sep 2027. Note: the fetch tool returns a model-made extraction of the page, not the raw text.
conflicts: Unofficial page showed 2 Feb 2026 as well (old text).
